subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 3/5] mountd: answer requests the kernel rejects on the netlink downcall

2026-09-09.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mountd service to handle rejected requests from the kernel when sending SET_REQS messages over netlink. When a request is rejected, it resubmits the batch one entry at a time and answers negative for any entries that are still refused by the kernel. This prevents pending requests from piling up and causing clients to hang on lookups. The patch also separates the kernel's errno from libnl's errors in cache_nl_set_reqs() and adds logging for size failures when sending large messages.
